subjects.name: Jocelyn Santo
subjects.profile: Jocelyn Santo — Yoga Instructor — Lake Merritt

sources.name: Serg Cerrano
sources.quote: After welcoming my new child, I felt the city's pace pulling me forward. Life's been busy, and I've been close to family a lot lately.

sources.name: Joseph Cramp
sources.quote: I've been a Janitor for 28 years, and I just got promoted. To be honest, it's still sinking in. It means more responsibilities, more fires to put out before noon, but it's a win for me. I'm not sure what comes next, but I'm ready to take it on.

sources.name: Travis Paiz
sources.quote: Setting up the household with Jocelyn was a whirlwind, to be honest. We just got married and were eager to start our life together. It's been a lot of work, but we're getting into a groove. We've got our routines down, and it's nice having someone to share the responsibilities with. Our little one is the light of our lives, and it's been great watching them adjust to our new setup.

sources.name: Jocelyn Santo
sources.quote: Setting up a household with Travis has been a whirlwind, to be honest. We just got married and are still figuring things out. It's been a big adjustment, but I'm excited to start this new chapter with him in Lake Merritt.

reviewProfile.purpose: Put the cycle's person events in the paper as news, one person at a time — a birth, a death, a hospital stay, a retirement, a promotion, a household set up or a place of one's own, a win or a loss on the book, what a turn of the city did to someone's day, and the smaller moments the record kept. approvedQuotes.text: After welcoming my new child, I felt the city's pace pulling me forward. Life's been busy, and I've been close to family a lot lately.

I've been a Janitor for 28 years, and I just got promoted. To be honest, it's still sinking in. It means more responsibilities, more fires to put out before noon, but it's a win for me. I'm not sure what comes next, but I'm ready to take it on.

Setting up the household with Jocelyn was a whirlwind, to be honest. We just got married and were eager to start our life together. It's been a lot of work, but we're getting into a groove. We've got our routines down, and it's nice having someone to share the responsibilities with. Our little one is the light of our lives, and it's been great watching them adjust to our new setup.
